name: hyphening-ads
description: Paid-media analysis fleet for the Hyphening Marketing Ops Center. Twelve agents over first-party campaign, lead and revenue data: efficiency, lead quality, funnel drop-off, true ROAS, budget reallocation, platform split, pacing, anomaly watch, creative signal, landing conversion and the client report. Every number is pre-computed by the Ops Center and handed to the agent as a fact pack; the agent interprets, it never calculates.
